findings.evidence: Find the theme (CSS custom properties, MUI `createTheme`, Tailwind theme; their defaults count) before the first value, so none starts as a literal.
findings.fix: Shorten this to one clause, for example 'Read the theme before writing the first value'. The model already looks for an existing theme; the tokens rule at its section already says what fails. Do the same for other build-step restatements of rules that are stated in full below.

findings.evidence: ## Review output sits after all eight rule sections, about 60 lines away from '### Review steps' (line 37), which only says 'Emit the table under Review output.'
findings.fix: Put the verdict test (fail/pass/na) and the 'established by' table directly under Review steps, so the Tool-pattern decision procedure reads in one sequence: steps, then verdict test, then rules.

findings.evidence: The Review output contract (Verdicts, Cells, Mandatory versus judgment, One defect one row) is about 60 lines and loads on every Build run, where the workflow says 'never the review table'
findings.fix: Move the Cells and One defect, one row subsections to references/review-output.md. In Review steps, add: 'Read references/review-output.md before emitting the table; do not load it for Build-only requests.' Keep the header and the verdict test inline.

findings.evidence: Default: the app's dev server plus Playwright or the harness browser tool at 320 CSS px ... and at 360, 768, 1280 and 1920 px ... CLS is the value a Lighthouse performance run reports
findings.fix: For Build runs, make the 320 px render plus one desktop width the default. Keep the full five-width matrix and Lighthouse for reviews and for changes that add breakpoints. List anything not rendered under `unverified`, as the hand-over already allows.

findings.evidence: The description lists 'theming and dark-mode setup (adding dark mode or a theme switch without per-component overrides)', but no output eval builds dark mode. The dark-mode trigger query has no matching output case.
findings.fix: Add an eval 'Add dark mode to this Tailwind app without dark: classes on every component', with a fixture. Assert that dark values switch at the root (tokens or colorSchemes), that no new dark: class appears on a component, and that the hand-over lists dark-theme contrast under unverified.

findings.evidence: '**Trap.** A second filled button in one view...' directly follows the Rule line at 69 with no blank line. In Markdown, Rule and Trap render as one paragraph, unlike every other rule section. The hierarchy Rule also packs the default, tie-break, destructive and two exceptions into one sentence chain.
findings.fix: Add a blank line before **Trap.** and split the hierarchy Rule into numbered items, as loading and responsive do: 1. at most one fill per view (view definition); 2. tie-break order; 3. destructive never filled; 4. the two cited exceptions.
